'''Endorian flytraps''' were large [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous plants]] found in the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The plants had [[Color/Legends|green]] bodies with orange and yellow leaves, and opened up like an animal's jaws. They had a long tongue-like appendage that could snap at a victim to attack it.
